from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfit(BaseModel):
    """Net profit after deducting non-recurring gains/losses for one company's period."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    profit_value: float | None = Field(description="Amount of deducted non-recurring net profit; a loss is negative")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit as written in the document (e.g. '元')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period this figure covers")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profits: list[CompanyProfit]
